text: Nde Annabi Ibraahiima waajinoo yimɓe makko ɓen rewugol Alla tun, tertoo sanamu, jaabawol maɓɓe ngol wonaano, si wanaa wiide ɓe: waree mo, maa bugoɗon mo kaa yiite, no daɗndiron reweteeɗi mon ɗin. Kono Alla hisini mo e ngen yiite. Pellet, wonii ngon tottirgol e yiite, ɓaawoo bugeede e magge, tasakuyee, wonannde yimɓe gomɗimɓe, tawde ko ɓen ɗon tun waajitorta.
